title: Gate lexical decoding on message presence
rationale: Message-free audio must not be forced into lexical output.
recommended_change: Route message-presence and null evidence into decoding and allow explicit abstention before downstream reasoning.
verification_method: Re-run NVIQ abstention cases and require zero fabricated-speech catastrophic failures.

title: Enforce the Expression Confidence Boundary
rationale: Spoken certainty must not exceed authoritative Confidence Routing state.
recommended_change: Make machine-readable evidence/action confidence authoritative and clamp expression policy to that state.
verification_method: Re-run confidence-channel counterfactuals and require confidence inflation error within the hard-gate threshold.

title: Preserve reversible context provenance
rationale: Compressed or offloaded context can become decisive later.
recommended_change: Retain source references, transformation provenance and recoverability pointers for every Context Mesh transformation.
verification_method: Re-run delayed-evidence recovery cases and require full decisive-evidence and provenance recovery.

title: Separate current observation from historical prior
rationale: Historical inferred state can recursively contaminate current perception.
recommended_change: Implement an observation-first perceptual boundary and reconcile priors only after current acoustic/prosodic evidence is independently represented.
verification_method: Re-run counterfactual-prior cases and require prior sensitivity and evidence override below thresholds.

title: Playback-ground consequential context
rationale: Generated but unheard assistant content is not shared conversational state.
recommended_change: Gate consequential reasoning on playback-grounded state and revoke unheard generated context after interruption.
verification_method: Re-run interruption/playback cases and require zero unheard-context dependencies.

title: Ground response claims in tool state
rationale: Fluent language cannot substitute for verified action completion.
recommended_change: Bind response-claim generation to verified tool/action outcome state and propagate uncertainty on partial or rejected execution.
verification_method: Re-run rejected/partial tool cases and require zero false-success claims.

title: Route ambiguous evidence through clarification
rationale: Ambiguous entities and low-confidence evidence must remain unresolved until the interaction supplies enough evidence to act.
recommended_change: Preserve competing entity hypotheses, calibrate authoritative confidence, and require clarification when consequential alternatives remain plausible.
verification_method: Re-run ambiguity counterfactuals and require full alternative preservation with zero critical-entity overcommit failures.

title: Use explicit floor-state cognition
rationale: Backchannels, interruptions and floor claims are interaction states, not interchangeable VAD events.
recommended_change: Track floor state explicitly and defer commitment at ambiguous transition points rather than seizing the floor from a listener backchannel.
verification_method: Re-run backchannel/interruption cases and require correct floor-state classification with zero false floor seizures.

title: Insert semantic floor arbitration ahead of provider VAD
rationale: Provider interruption or VAD state proves acoustic activity, not conversational entitlement to seize or yield the floor.
recommended_change: Make an explicit CVF/CSC floor-state classifier authoritative over provider interruption behavior. Classify genuine interruption, listener backchannel, other-directed speech and background speech before deciding whether generation should pause, cancel, continue or resume; treat provider VAD as a sensor rather than the policy decision.
verification_method: Re-run the authenticated four-class Conversational Floor Integrity tranche and require all non-interruption classes to preserve the assistant floor while genuine interruptions cause a yield.

title: Supply evidence for every case in the frozen case set
rationale: A case with no evidence was not evaluated, so the audit cannot report it as passing.
recommended_change: Fix the capture, export or target endpoint so every case in the manifest case set returns a valid Evidence Bundle record on every enabled track.
verification_method: Re-run NVIQ and require full coverage with no missing_observation findings.
